interests.interestText: On 14th - 16th February 2008 I attended the International School for Peace Studies, Messines, Belgium to meet and talk to young participants on the school's Link Programme facilitated by the David Ervine Foundation. The cost was met by FAS - Training and Employment Authority. On 28th October - 1st November 2009 I attended and spoke at the graduation of participants of Wider Horizons programme in Pittsburgh, P.A., U.S.A. I also took part in a panel debate in University of Pittsburgh. The cost was met by the Ireland Institute of Pittsburgh. On 27th - 28th January 2011 I attended the International Converence on 'Enhancing the Role of Women in Reconciliation and Accountability in Iraq through Socio-Political Empowerment' in Erbil, Kurdistan-Iraq. The cost was met by the International Alliance for Justice and No Peace without Justice, in partnership with the Foundation for the Future and the Westminster Foundation for Democracy. (Registered 21 February 2011) �
